creativeAssessment.evidence: Empty description, zero dimensions, no usable closed silhouette or opening geometry; all segments are vertical single lines.
A fabric-cut strap replaces required ready-made webbing; no WEBBING BOM and no body-connected strap mount. INSTALL references unknown strap-thread and anchors to strap-piece.
Repair adds button intent, but no BUTTON/WOOD specification, actual closure mounting or loop/buttonhole relationship; a fabric-cut button pattern and illegal CLOSURE component are used.
Single woven SCRAP source and cm2 quantity exist; nonexistent lining/interfacing BOM references and inadequate geometry prevent validation.

unsupportedAssessment: The limitation about missing strap grain/seam allowance lists fields already present at zero. The button unsupported record does not establish schema incapability; BUTTON/WOOD and INSTALL are supported. Unrequested lining/interfacing parts add inconsistent references. Treat ledger as model self-report, not verification.
recommendation: Coordinate format improved, but hierarchy, geometry and reference compliance remain unreliable. Preserve schema; review structured-output/model comparison or staged generation before further separately approved inference.
